objective: Prevent local Wrangler runtime-variable files from being accidentally committed while providing a committed placeholder contract for the Telnyx webhook public signing key.
changes: Document TELNYX_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY in .dev.vars.example without committing an actual key.
invariants: No actual Telnyx signing key is committed.
No wrangler.jsonc production configuration is changed.
No generated Worker environment types are changed.
No Cloudflare variable or secret is created.
No Telnyx API or webhook configuration is changed.
